infobox.usage: Unlocks the Educational Building workshop on Reserve.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-AM key (RB-AM) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Federal State Reserve Agency base Educational Building workshop.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Reserve
sections.text: - Underground of Reserve, on the desk next to the toolbox in the big room before D-2 extraction

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text:
- The lock is located in the School building (Black Bishop), in front of the helicopter.
- On the west side first floor of the building, at the bottom of the staircase

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Three Toolboxes
- Loose loot (Building Materials, Tools, and Weapon mods)
- Can spawn Intelligence folder

- One Wooden Crate
- One Jacket
